scenes.text: Multiply the numerator and denominator by the same nonzero number to make an equivalent fraction.
Complete: 1/5 equals ?/10. The answer is 2. Multiply numerator and denominator by 2: 2/10.
A recipe fraction during a sports day is 3/10. What is an equivalent fraction with denominator 30? Pause the video and think.
A recipe fraction during a sports day is 3/10. What is an equivalent fraction with denominator 30? The answer is 9. Multiply numerator and denominator by 3: 9/30.
